Title: Willow Pump | BBB Complaints | Better Business Bureau
This profile includes complaints for Willow Pump's headquarters and its corporate-owned locations. I purchased the Willow Go Pump. I purchased a Willow Go breast pump through the Willow Amazon storefront in January 2024. I have purchased a willow go pump from Amazon (which the company says it is an approved way to purchase the pumps) I went on Amazon and purchased my pumps on 10/09/2023. Then the next day I was told that because I purchased from Amazon that they will not warranty my pumps. Purchased willow go pump on amazon from the seller Willow store. Contacted Willow customer care and they said I need a new pump replacement. They said they won't replace my pump because it's not under warranty since I didn't buy it directly from them though Amazon shows Willow store as the seller. I purchased the Willow Go Pump and Anywhere Case Bundle which was listed to include a pump and case. I purchased a Willow Go breast pump on Feb 5th 2024 and out of the box they didnt work. This is a known issue with their product and my only satisfactory solution will be a refund so I can purchase another type of pump. On 7/19/23 I purchased a Willow GO breast pump (and a set of 7oz collection cups) from the Willow website. Total spent (w/tax) was $306.34.On 9/5/23 I reached out to Willow customer service because my right pump had seized up and stopped working. On 9/13/23, I again reached out to Willow customer service because the left pump had also seized up and stopped working. Willow replaced the pump.On 11/9/23, I was again forced to reach out to Willow customer service because 1 of the 2 latches that hold the milk collection cup on to the pump had broken, rendering the pump unusable. I have spent $621.65 on Willow Go pump system and have no working pumps. On September 09, 2023, I purchase from the Company Willow a pair of Willow 3.0 wearable Breast Pumps for $450.00 including shipping also 2 milk containers for $49.99 + $14.99 shipping and handling. ## Willow Pump is NOT a BBB Accredited Business.
